Note::flatten¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

Note Note::flatten() const

Collapse Every Axis Into One¶

flatten() returns a rank-1 Note containing the same cells in the same row-major order. It is reshape({numel()}) with nothing to compute — the shortcut you reach for before an operation that expects a flat list, or when you no longer care about the grid structure.

No text is touched: cells are shared with the source, the bytes-vs-UTF-8 mode carries over, and only the shape metadata changes.

Behaviour by rank¶

Input

Result

rank 2 or 3

rank 1, [numel()]

rank 1

returned unchanged

rank 0 (scalar)

rank 1, [1]

An empty Note flattens to a rank-1 Note of length 0.

Example 1: Grid To List¶

const auto m = pluss::make_note({{"a", "b", "c"}, {"d", "e", "f"}});
std::cout << pluss::note::print(m.flatten()) << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[6], dim=1, numel=6, encoding=utf8)
["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"]

Row 0 then row 1 — the same order the cells are stored in.

Example 2: Already Rank 1¶

const auto v = pluss::make_note({"a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"});
std::cout << pluss::note::print(v.flatten()) << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[6], dim=1, numel=6, encoding=utf8)
["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"]

Example 3: A Scalar Becomes A One-Element List¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(pluss::make_note("solo").flatten()) << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[1], dim=1, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
["solo"]

See Also¶

  • Note::reshape: the general form — flatten is the rank-1 case.

  • Note::squeeze: drop only the size-1 axes, keeping the rest of the grid.

  • Note::join: collapse the cells into a single string rather than a flat list.
